sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 1** across burlesque parody detective debuts, historic World War I battlefield phonograph addresses from France, concert operetta showcases, comic strip sorcery serials, and big band transcription sessions, Bud Abbott and Lou Costello debuting Sam Shovel (1948), General John J. Pershing's 1918 address from Chaumont, France, Nelson Eddy on *The Electric Hour* (1946), *Mandrake the Magician* (1941), Martha Tilton with Billy Mills (1950), and *Plantation Echoes* (1918–1950):
